_comment: Cards that exist only for the prepared test (tests/unit/test_prepared.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_emeritus` is Emeritus of Woe // Demonic Tutor: it enters prepared, and while it is you may cast a copy of `t_tutor`. `t_unprepared` is the counterfactual -- the same creature without the entering clause. `t_tutor_two` exists only because a spell face belongs to exactly one card, the way a second face does.
